items.body: Behavior checking classifies only setup-derived contradictions as unsatisfiable. A mechanically contradictory behavior such as `actionsExactly = [requestCancel]` combined with `sequences = [[callerClose]]` is intentionally left `unclassified` (`BehaviorTests.lean:313-324`). If no enumerated target trace satisfies such a behavior, `planLoop` reaches `.complete`; `finalizePlanning` then returns `.verified` for an exhaustive verification because it checks only the static `spaceStatus`. This violates the requirements that contradictory constraints fail checking and that an empty behavior never becomes successful universal verification.
items.suggestion: Validate contradictions involving exact schedules/traces, sequence, adjacency, and ordering during behavior checking. Independently, track whether exhaustive planning encountered any behavior-admitted trace and finalize zero-admission completion as `unsatisfiable`, never `verified`.
